def select_universe(raw: pd.DataFrame, start_year: int, end_year: int,
                    selected_sectors: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None,
                    restrict_fossil_fuels: bool = False) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Returns the rows of `raw` inside [start_year, end_year] that pass the sector and
    fossil fuel filters. `raw` is never modified and is not copied whole: all filters
    form one row mask and only the kept rows are copied. When nothing is filtered out,
    the result is a shallow copy that shares raw's columns, so treat it as read-only.
    """
    keep = (raw['Year'] >= int(start_year)) & (raw['Year'] <= int(end_year))

    sectors = list(selected_sectors or [])
    if sectors:
        keep &= raw['Scotts_Sector_5'].isin(sectors)

    if restrict_fossil_fuels:
        industry_col = 'FactSet_Industry' if 'FactSet_Industry' in raw.columns else 'FactSet Industry'
        if industry_col in raw.columns:
            clean_ind = raw[industry_col].str.lower().str.replace(r'[^a-z0-9]', '', regex=True)
            keep &= ~clean_ind.isin(FOSSIL_FUEL_INDUSTRIES)

    if keep.all():
        # Nothing filtered out: share raw's columns instead of copying them. The shallow
        # copy is still a new DataFrame, so adding or dropping columns on it never touches
        # raw, and each call gives a new object (the Data Viewer uses that to notice reloads).
        return raw.copy(deep=False)
    return raw[keep.to_numpy()]   # copies only the kept rows

docs.title: period_boundaries
docs.text:
period_boundaries(frequency: str, start_year: int, end_year: int, first_month: str = FIRST_MONTH, last_month: str = LAST_MONTH) -> List[str]

The run's rebalance months followed by the month its last holding period ends, as 'YYYY-MM'. Holding period i runs from boundary i to boundary i + 1.

The backtest covers the calendar years start_year to end_year: it rebalances first in December of start_year - 1 and ends in December of end_year. Where the data does not reach that far, it starts at the first rebalance month in the data and ends at the last one, so there are no partial periods.

Raises:

Type Description ValueError

unknown frequency, years outside the data, or no complete period.

Source code in src/wrds_calendar.py 
def period_boundaries(frequency: str, start_year: int, end_year: int,
                      first_month: str = FIRST_MONTH, last_month: str = LAST_MONTH) -> List[str]:
    """
    The run's rebalance months followed by the month its last holding period ends,
    as 'YYYY-MM'. Holding period i runs from boundary i to boundary i + 1.

    The backtest covers the calendar years start_year to end_year: it rebalances first
    in December of start_year - 1 and ends in December of end_year. Where the data does
    not reach that far, it starts at the first rebalance month in the data and ends at
    the last one, so there are no partial periods.

    Raises:
        ValueError: unknown frequency, years outside the data, or no complete period.
    """
    if frequency not in FREQUENCIES:
        raise ValueError(f"frequency must be one of {FREQUENCIES}, not '{frequency}'.")
    first_year, last_year = int(first_month[:4]), int(last_month[:4])
    start_year, end_year = int(start_year), int(end_year)
    if not first_year <= start_year <= end_year <= last_year:
        raise ValueError(f"Choose years from {first_year} to {last_year}, with the start year "
                         f"not after the end year (got {start_year}-{end_year}).")

    lo = max(_index(f"{start_year - 1}-12"), _index(first_month))
    hi = min(_index(f"{end_year}-12"), _index(last_month))
    months = [_month(i) for i in range(lo, hi + 1) if i % 12 + 1 in REBALANCE_MONTHS[frequency]]
    if len(months) < 2:
        raise ValueError(f"{start_year}-{end_year} has no complete {frequency} holding period "
                         f"in the data ({first_month} to {last_month}).")
    return months

describe_schedule(frequency: str, start_year: int, end_year: int) -> str

One line for the sidebar, e.g. "12 quarterly rebalances, 2009-12 to 2012-09; holds to 2012-12".

Source code in src/wrds_calendar.py 
def describe_schedule(frequency: str, start_year: int, end_year: int) -> str:
    """One line for the sidebar, e.g. "12 quarterly rebalances, 2009-12 to 2012-09; holds to 2012-12"."""
    months = period_boundaries(frequency, start_year, end_year)
    label = {'semiannual': 'semi-annual'}.get(frequency, frequency)
    count = len(months) - 1
    return (f"{count} {label} rebalance{'s' if count > 1 else ''}, "
            f"{months[0]} to {months[-2]}; holds to {months[-1]}")

PROJECT: Factor-Lake Portfolio Analysis MODULE: src/wrds_data.py PURPOSE: Loads the columns of the WRDS files a WRDS backtest reads, locally or from S3. VERSION: 1.0.0

Three files of the WRDS pull (pipeline/DATA_DICTIONARY.md) are read, each as bytes and then decoded with only the needed columns, the same way from a local folder and from S3:

  • factor_panel_monthly.parquet: the universe at each month end, the allowlisted factors, price and market cap. Columns about the month after t (ret_next_1m, delisted_next_month) are never read.
  • returns_monthly.parquet: every stock's monthly return (delisting return included) and its delisting month, also after it leaves the index.
  • market_monthly.parquet: IWM, IWN and IWO total returns and the risk-free rate.

docs.text:
build(panel: DataFrame, returns_monthly: DataFrame, market: DataFrame) -> WrdsData

Builds the return matrices from returns_monthly (one row per month end and permno).

Source code in src/wrds_data.py 
@classmethod
def build(cls, panel: pd.DataFrame, returns_monthly: pd.DataFrame, market: pd.DataFrame) -> 'WrdsData':
    """Builds the return matrices from returns_monthly (one row per month end and permno)."""
    panel = panel.copy()
    for col in ('ticker', 'security_name', 'sector_name'):
        panel[col] = panel[col].astype('category')
    # Every month end of either file; a holding period over a month without market data is refused
    months = pd.DatetimeIndex(returns_monthly['month_end'].unique()).union(
        pd.DatetimeIndex(market['month_end'])).sort_values()
    market = market.set_index('month_end').reindex(months)
    permnos = pd.Index(np.sort(returns_monthly['permno'].unique()))
    rows = months.get_indexer(returns_monthly['month_end'])
    cols = permnos.get_indexer(returns_monthly['permno'])
    returns = np.full((len(months), len(permnos)), np.nan)
    returns[rows, cols] = returns_monthly['ret_m'].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    delisted = np.zeros((len(months), len(permnos)), dtype=bool)
    delisted[rows, cols] = returns_monthly['delisted_in_month'].to_numpy(dtype=bool)
    return cls(panel=panel, months=months, permnos=permnos, returns=returns,
               delisted=delisted, market=market,
               _month_dates={d.strftime('%Y-%m'): d for d in months})

def read_wrds_data(read_bytes: Callable[[str], bytes]) -> WrdsData:
    """
    Reads the three WRDS files through read_bytes(filename) and decodes only the needed
    columns. Each file's bytes are released before the next file is read.
    """
    frames = []
    for filename, columns in ((PANEL_FILE, PANEL_COLUMNS), (RETURNS_FILE, RETURNS_COLUMNS),
                              (MARKET_FILE, MARKET_COLUMNS)):
        frames.append(pd.read_parquet(io.BytesIO(read_bytes(filename)), columns=list(columns)))
    return WrdsData.build(*frames)

docs.text:
PROJECT: Factor-Lake Portfolio Analysis MODULE: src/wrds_engine.py PURPOSE: Vectorized WRDS backtest: point-in-time universe, factor scores, buy-and-hold periods. VERSION: 1.0.0

See DOCS/WRDS_MODE_DESIGN.md, sections 3, 4 and 7. At each rebalance date t:

  1. Universe: the panel rows at t (Russell 2000 members known at t) with a price and a market cap, after the sector and fossil fuel filters. Nothing dated after t is read.
  2. Scores: each factor's z-score per date, exactly as Legacy's normalize_series (winsorize at 1% / 99%, negate for 'bottom', z-score with ddof=1). Integrating ranks the mean z-score of stocks that have every factor; Mixing ranks each factor in its own sleeve with an equal share of the money.
  3. Selection: the top max(1, floor(n * top_pct / 100)) by score, ties broken by permno, equal or market cap (mkt_cap_musd at t) weighted.
  4. Holding period (t, t']: buy and hold, so weights drift with each stock's compounded monthly returns (delisting returns included). After a stock's delisting month its money earns the risk-free rate until t'. A month without a return, before any delisting, counts as 0% and is counted in missing_return_stock_months.

Stocks are keyed on permno (two securities can share a ticker on one date).

def validate_inputs(factors: List[str], factor_directions: Dict[str, str], factor_combination: str,
                    top_pct: float, selected_sectors: Optional[Iterable[str]]) -> None:
    """Raises ValueError for inputs a WRDS backtest cannot run."""
    if not factors:
        raise ValueError("A backtest needs at least one factor.")
    if bad := [f for f in factors if f not in WRDS_FACTOR_COLUMNS]:
        raise ValueError(f"Not WRDS factors: {bad}. Factors must be columns known at the rebalance date.")
    if bad := [d for d in (factor_directions.get(f, 'top') for f in factors) if d not in ('top', 'bottom')]:
        raise ValueError(f"Factor directions must be 'top' or 'bottom', not {bad}.")
    if factor_combination not in FACTOR_COMBINATIONS:
        raise ValueError(f"factor_combination must be one of {FACTOR_COMBINATIONS}, not '{factor_combination}'.")
    if not 0 < top_pct <= 100:
        raise ValueError("top_pct must be above 0 and at most 100.")
    if bad := [s for s in (selected_sectors or []) if s not in WRDS_SECTORS]:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown GICS sectors: {bad}.")

eligible_universe(panel: DataFrame, restrict_fossil_fuels: bool = False, selected_sectors: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None) -> pd.DataFrame

The panel rows a backtest can buy: a positive price and market cap at t, in the selected GICS sectors (Unclassified stocks are left out while a sector filter is on) and, with restrict_fossil_fuels, not a fossil fuel company.

Source code in src/wrds_engine.py 
def eligible_universe(panel: pd.DataFrame, restrict_fossil_fuels: bool = False,
                      selected_sectors: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    The panel rows a backtest can buy: a positive price and market cap at t, in the
    selected GICS sectors (Unclassified stocks are left out while a sector filter is
    on) and, with restrict_fossil_fuels, not a fossil fuel company.
    """
    keep = (panel['prc'] > 0) & (panel['mkt_cap_musd'] > 0)
    sectors = list(selected_sectors or [])
    if sectors:
        keep &= panel['sector_name'].isin(sectors)
    if restrict_fossil_fuels:
        gsubind = panel['gsubind']
        fossil = (gsubind.isin(FOSSIL_GSUBIND).to_numpy(dtype=bool, na_value=False)
                  | (gsubind.isna().to_numpy() & panel['siccd'].isin(FOSSIL_SIC).to_numpy()))
        keep &= ~fossil
    return panel[keep.to_numpy()]

docs.title: factor_zscores
docs.text:
factor_zscores(universe: DataFrame, column: str, higher_is_better: bool) -> pd.Series

One factor's z-scores within each date, as Legacy's normalize_series computes them for one year: non-numbers and infinities become NaN, values are capped at the date's 1% and 99% quantiles, negated when lower is better, then z-scored (ddof=1). A date whose values do not vary is only centered.

Source code in src/wrds_engine.py 
def factor_zscores(universe: pd.DataFrame, column: str, higher_is_better: bool) -> pd.Series:
    """
    One factor's z-scores within each date, as Legacy's normalize_series computes them
    for one year: non-numbers and infinities become NaN, values are capped at the date's
    1% and 99% quantiles, negated when lower is better, then z-scored (ddof=1). A date
    whose values do not vary is only centered.
    """
    s = pd.to_numeric(universe[column], errors='coerce').replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    by_date = s.groupby(universe['date'])
    s = s.clip(by_date.transform('quantile', WINSORIZE_PCT), by_date.transform('quantile', 1 - WINSORIZE_PCT))
    if not higher_is_better:
        s = -s
    by_date = s.groupby(universe['date'])
    centered = s - by_date.transform('mean')
    sigma = by_date.transform('std')
    return pd.Series(np.where(sigma > 1e-12, centered / sigma, centered), index=s.index)

select_positions(universe: DataFrame, factors: List[str], factor_directions: Dict[str, str], factor_combination: str = 'mixing', top_pct: float = 10.0, use_market_cap_weight: bool = False) -> pd.DataFrame

The positions bought at every date in universe: date, sleeve, permno, rank (within the sleeve), score, and weight (share of the whole portfolio; each date sums to 1).

Integrating is one sleeve ranked by the mean z-score of the stocks that have every factor. Mixing is one sleeve per factor, each with 1 / len(factors) of the money.

Source code in src/wrds_engine.py 
def select_positions(universe: pd.DataFrame, factors: List[str], factor_directions: Dict[str, str],
                     factor_combination: str = 'mixing', top_pct: float = 10.0,
                     use_market_cap_weight: bool = False) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    The positions bought at every date in universe: date, sleeve, permno, rank (within
    the sleeve), score, and weight (share of the whole portfolio; each date sums to 1).

    Integrating is one sleeve ranked by the mean z-score of the stocks that have every
    factor. Mixing is one sleeve per factor, each with 1 / len(factors) of the money.
    """
    zscores = {f: factor_zscores(universe, f, factor_directions.get(f, 'top') == 'top') for f in factors}
    if factor_combination == 'integrating':
        composite = pd.concat(zscores.values(), axis=1)
        composite = composite.mean(axis=1).where(composite.notna().all(axis=1))
        sleeves = [_top_ranked(universe, composite, top_pct, use_market_cap_weight).assign(sleeve=0)]
    else:
        sleeves = []
        for i, f in enumerate(factors):
            sleeve = _top_ranked(universe, zscores[f], top_pct, use_market_cap_weight)
            sleeves.append(sleeve.assign(sleeve=i, weight=sleeve['weight'] / len(factors)))
    positions = pd.concat(sleeves, ignore_index=True)
    return positions[['date', 'sleeve', 'permno', 'rank', 'score', 'weight']]

rank_stocks(data: WrdsData, date: Timestamp, factors: List[str], factor_directions: Dict[str, str], factor_combination: str = 'mixing', top_pct: float = 10.0, use_market_cap_weight: bool = False, restrict_fossil_fuels: bool = False, selected_sectors: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None) -> pd.DataFrame

Every stock a backtest could buy on one rebalance date, ranked: its raw factor values and z-scores (z_), the composite score (mean z-score, only for stocks with every factor) with its rank, each factor's own rank (rank_, the Mixing sleeves), and whether the strategy holds it and with what weight. Source code in src/wrds_engine.py 

def rank_stocks(data: WrdsData, date: pd.Timestamp, factors: List[str], factor_directions: Dict[str, str],
                factor_combination: str = 'mixing', top_pct: float = 10.0, use_market_cap_weight: bool = False,
                restrict_fossil_fuels: bool = False,
                selected_sectors: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Every stock a backtest could buy on one rebalance date, ranked: its raw factor
    values and z-scores (z_<column>), the composite score (mean z-score, only for stocks
    with every factor) with its rank, each factor's own rank (rank_<column>, the Mixing
    sleeves), and whether the strategy holds it and with what weight.
    """
    validate_inputs(factors, factor_directions, factor_combination, top_pct, selected_sectors)
    columns = list(dict.fromkeys(['date', 'permno', 'ticker', 'security_name', 'sector_name', 'gsubind',
                                  'siccd', 'prc', 'mkt_cap_musd'] + list(factors)))
    panel = data.panel.loc[(data.panel['date'] == date).to_numpy(), columns]
    if panel.empty:
        raise ValueError(f"The WRDS panel has no rows on {date.date()}.")
    universe = eligible_universe(panel, restrict_fossil_fuels, selected_sectors)

    table = universe[['permno', 'ticker', 'security_name', 'sector_name', 'prc', 'mkt_cap_musd']].copy()
    zscores = {}
    for f in factors:
        zscores[f] = factor_zscores(universe, f, factor_directions.get(f, 'top') == 'top')
        table[f] = universe[f]
        table[f'z_{f}'] = zscores[f]
    z = pd.concat(zscores.values(), axis=1)
    table['score'] = z.mean(axis=1).where(z.notna().all(axis=1))
    table['rank'] = _ranks(table['score'], table['permno'])
    if factor_combination == 'mixing':
        for f in factors:
            table[f'rank_{f}'] = _ranks(zscores[f], table['permno'])

    held = select_positions(universe, factors, factor_directions, factor_combination, top_pct,
                            use_market_cap_weight).groupby('permno')['weight'].sum()
    table['held'] = table['permno'].isin(held.index)
    table['weight'] = table['permno'].map(held).fillna(0.0)
    table = table.rename(columns={'security_name': 'name', 'sector_name': 'sector', 'prc': 'price'})
    for col in ('ticker', 'name', 'sector'):
        table[col] = table[col].astype(object)
    return table.sort_values(['rank', 'permno'], na_position='last').reset_index(drop=True)

holding_period_growth(data: WrdsData, permnos: ndarray, start: Timestamp, end: Timestamp, rf_monthly: ndarray) -> pd.DataFrame

Buy-and-hold growth of each stock over (start, end]: the product of (1 + monthly return), and after its delisting month (1 + risk-free) instead. A month without a return before any delisting counts as 0%.

Returns one row per permno: growth, delisted (in the period), missing_return_months.

Source code in src/wrds_engine.py 
def holding_period_growth(data: WrdsData, permnos: np.ndarray, start: pd.Timestamp,
                          end: pd.Timestamp, rf_monthly: np.ndarray) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Buy-and-hold growth of each stock over (start, end]: the product of (1 + monthly
    return), and after its delisting month (1 + risk-free) instead. A month without a
    return before any delisting counts as 0%.

    Returns one row per permno: growth, delisted (in the period), missing_return_months.
    """
    months = _month_range(data, start, end)
    cols = data.permnos.get_indexer(permnos)
    known = cols >= 0                                      # stocks never in returns_monthly have no returns
    returns = np.where(known, data.returns[months][:, cols], np.nan)
    delisted = np.where(known, data.delisted[months][:, cols], False)
    after_delisting = (np.cumsum(delisted, axis=0) - delisted) > 0
    missing = np.isnan(returns) & ~after_delisting
    monthly = np.where(after_delisting, 1.0 + rf_monthly[months][:, None],
                       np.where(missing, 1.0, 1.0 + np.nan_to_num(returns)))
    return pd.DataFrame({'permno': permnos, 'growth': monthly.prod(axis=0),
                         'delisted': delisted.any(axis=0), 'missing_return_months': missing.sum(axis=0)})

Backtests the holding periods between consecutive dates (rebalancing at every date but the last). See run_wrds_backtest for the arguments and the results.

Source code in src/wrds_engine.py 
def run_periods(data: WrdsData, dates: List[pd.Timestamp], factors: List[str],
                factor_directions: Dict[str, str], initial_aum: float, periods_per_year: int,
                frequency: Optional[str] = None, top_pct: float = 10.0,
                use_market_cap_weight: bool = False, factor_combination: str = 'mixing',
                restrict_fossil_fuels: bool = False, selected_sectors: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None,
                factor_labels: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], pd.DataFrame]:
    """
    Backtests the holding periods between consecutive dates (rebalancing at every date
    but the last). See run_wrds_backtest for the arguments and the results.
    """
    validate_inputs(factors, factor_directions, factor_combination, top_pct, selected_sectors)
    if len(dates) < 2:
        raise ValueError("A backtest needs at least one holding period.")
    factor_labels = factor_labels or {}
    rebalance_dates, period_ends = list(dates[:-1]), list(dates[1:])
    in_panel = pd.DatetimeIndex(rebalance_dates).isin(data.panel_dates())
    if missing := [d.date().isoformat() for d, ok in zip(rebalance_dates, in_panel) if not ok]:
        raise ValueError(f"The WRDS panel has no rows on the rebalance dates {missing}.")

    # Only the columns this run needs, and only the rebalance dates' rows, are copied
    columns = list(dict.fromkeys(['date', 'permno', 'ticker', 'security_name', 'sector_name', 'gsubind',
                                  'siccd', 'prc', 'mkt_cap_musd'] + list(factors)))
    panel = data.panel.loc[data.panel['date'].isin(rebalance_dates).to_numpy(), columns]
    universe = eligible_universe(panel, restrict_fossil_fuels, selected_sectors)
    positions = select_positions(universe, factors, factor_directions, factor_combination,
                                 top_pct, use_market_cap_weight)

    rf_monthly, rf_filled = _risk_free(data)
    by_date = dict(tuple(positions.groupby('date')))
    period_returns, rf_period, growth_rows = [], [], []
    benchmarks = {role: [] for role in BENCHMARK_COLUMNS}
    used_months = np.zeros(len(data.months), dtype=bool)
    for start, end in zip(rebalance_dates, period_ends):
        months = _month_range(data, start, end)
        used_months[months] = True
        rf_period.append(float(np.prod(1.0 + rf_monthly[months]) - 1.0))
        for role, column in BENCHMARK_COLUMNS.items():
            monthly = data.market[column].to_numpy(dtype=float)[months]
            if np.isnan(monthly).any():
                raise ValueError(f"market_monthly has no {column} for a month of {start.date()} to {end.date()}.")
            benchmarks[role].append(float(np.prod(1.0 + monthly) - 1.0))

        held = by_date.get(start)
        if held is None:          # nothing to buy (e.g. a narrow sector filter): the money earns rf
            period_returns.append(rf_period[-1])
            continue
        growth = holding_period_growth(data, held['permno'].unique(), start, end, rf_monthly)
        growth_rows.append(growth.assign(date=start))
        g = held['permno'].map(growth.set_index('permno')['growth'])
        period_returns.append(float((held['weight'] * g).sum() - 1.0))

    values = [float(initial_aum)]
    for r in period_returns:
        values.append(values[-1] * (1.0 + r))

    p_ret = np.array(period_returns)
    results = compute_comprehensive_metrics(
        p_ret, np.array(benchmarks['benchmark']), np.array(benchmarks['growth']),
        np.array(benchmarks['value']), np.array(rf_period), values, 0, len(p_ret),
        periods_per_year=periods_per_year)

    labels = [d.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') for d in dates]
    for i, comparison in enumerate(results['yearly_comparisons']):
        comparison.update(year=period_ends[i].year, period_start=labels[i], period_end=labels[i + 1])
    growth = (pd.concat(growth_rows, ignore_index=True) if growth_rows
              else pd.DataFrame(columns=['date', 'permno', 'growth', 'delisted', 'missing_return_months']))
    results.update(
        data_mode='wrds',
        frequency=frequency,
        periods_per_year=periods_per_year,
        years=labels,                       # start of the first period, then each period's end
        rebalance_dates=labels[:-1],
        period_end_dates=labels[1:],
        cagr=(values[-1] / values[0]) ** (periods_per_year / len(p_ret)) - 1.0,
        rf_returns=(np.array(rf_period) * 100).tolist(),
        benchmark_labels=dict(BENCHMARK_LABELS),
        risk_free_rate_source=RISK_FREE_SOURCE,
        rf_filled_months=[m.strftime('%Y-%m') for m in data.months[rf_filled & used_months]],
        factor_combination=factor_combination,
        total_delisted_positions=int(growth['delisted'].sum()),
        missing_return_stock_months=int(growth['missing_return_months'].sum()),
        empty_rebalance_dates=[d.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') for d in rebalance_dates if d not in by_date],
    )
    holdings = _holdings_table(positions, growth, panel, values, rebalance_dates, factors,
                               factor_combination, factor_labels)
    return results, holdings

def run_wrds_backtest(data: WrdsData, factors: List[str], factor_directions: Dict[str, str],
                      frequency: str, start_year: int, end_year: int, initial_aum: float,
                      top_pct: float = 10.0, use_market_cap_weight: bool = False,
                      factor_combination: str = 'mixing', restrict_fossil_fuels: bool = False,
                      selected_sectors: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None,
                      factor_labels: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
                      first_month: str = FIRST_MONTH,
                      last_month: str = LAST_MONTH) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], pd.DataFrame]:
    """
    Backtests factor portfolios on the WRDS data, rebalanced at the frequency's month
    ends over the calendar years start_year to end_year (src/wrds_calendar.py).

    Args:
        factors: allowlisted panel columns (src/wrds_factors.WRDS_FACTOR_COLUMNS).
        factor_directions: column -> 'top' (higher is better) or 'bottom'.
        frequency: 'semiannual', 'quarterly' or 'monthly'.
        factor_labels: column -> display name, for picked_by in the holdings.
        first_month: the data's first month, 'YYYY-MM' (tests use shorter data).
        last_month: the data's last month with returns, 'YYYY-MM'.

    Returns:
        (results, holdings). results has the keys of compute_comprehensive_metrics, with
        per-period returns (in percent, under the Legacy key names such as yearly_returns),
        metrics annualized by frequency, 'years' as the period boundary dates, plus
        rebalance_dates, period_end_dates, cagr, benchmark_labels, rf_returns,
        rf_filled_months, total_delisted_positions, missing_return_stock_months and
        empty_rebalance_dates. holdings is one row per stock held per rebalance date
        (see _holdings_table).
    """
    months = period_boundaries(frequency, start_year, end_year, first_month, last_month)
    dates = [data.month_date(m) for m in months]
    return run_periods(data, dates, factors, factor_directions, initial_aum, PERIODS_PER_YEAR[frequency],
                       frequency=frequency, top_pct=top_pct, use_market_cap_weight=use_market_cap_weight,
                       factor_combination=factor_combination, restrict_fossil_fuels=restrict_fossil_fuels,
                       selected_sectors=selected_sectors, factor_labels=factor_labels)

def holdings_parquet(holdings: pd.DataFrame) -> Tuple[bytes, Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    The holdings (sorted by rebalance_date) as Parquet bytes with one row group per
    rebalance date, and {'dates': [...], 'rows': [...]} listing the row groups in order.
    """
    table = pa.Table.from_pandas(holdings, preserve_index=False)
    dates = holdings['rebalance_date']
    if not dates.is_monotonic_increasing:
        raise ValueError("Holdings must be sorted by rebalance_date.")
    counts = dates.value_counts(sort=False).sort_index()
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    with pq.ParquetWriter(buffer, table.schema, compression='zstd') as writer:
        start = 0
        for count in counts:
            writer.write_table(table.slice(start, int(count)), row_group_size=int(count))
            start += int(count)
    return buffer.getvalue(), {'dates': [d.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') for d in counts.index],
                               'rows': [int(c) for c in counts]}

One rebalance date's holdings from a holdings file in S3, with ranged GETs: the footer, then only that date's row group. row_group is the date's position in the result's holdings['dates']; date (YYYY-MM-DD), when given, is checked against the rows.

def read_holdings_date(manager, filename: str, row_group: int, date: Optional[str] = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    One rebalance date's holdings from a holdings file in S3, with ranged GETs: the
    footer, then only that date's row group. row_group is the date's position in the
    result's holdings['dates']; date (YYYY-MM-DD), when given, is checked against the rows.
    """
    tail, size = _get_range(manager, filename, f'-{TAIL_BYTES}')
    if tail[-4:] != b'PAR1':
        raise ValueError(f"{filename} is not a Parquet file.")
    ranges = _Ranges(size)
    ranges.add(size - len(tail), tail)
    footer = int.from_bytes(tail[-8:-4], 'little') + 8
    if footer > len(tail):
        body, _ = _get_range(manager, filename, f'{size - footer}-{size - 1}')
        ranges.add(size - footer, body)

    parquet = pq.ParquetFile(ranges, pre_buffer=False)
    if not 0 <= row_group < parquet.metadata.num_row_groups:
        raise ValueError(f"{filename} has no row group {row_group}.")
    group = parquet.metadata.row_group(row_group)
    starts = [c.dictionary_page_offset if c.has_dictionary_page else c.data_page_offset
              for c in (group.column(i) for i in range(group.num_columns))]
    start = min(starts)
    end = max(s + group.column(i).total_compressed_size for i, s in enumerate(starts))
    if not ranges.has(start, end):
        body, _ = _get_range(manager, filename, f'{start}-{end - 1}')
        ranges.add(start, body)

    holdings = parquet.read_row_group(row_group).to_pandas()
    if date is not None and not holdings.empty and holdings['rebalance_date'].iloc[0].strftime('%Y-%m-%d') != date:
        raise ValueError(f"Row group {row_group} of {filename} is not {date}.")
    return holdings

def build_wrds_job(kind: str, factors: List[str], factor_directions: Dict[str, str], settings: Dict[str, Any],
                   factor_labels: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None, cohort_pct: Optional[float] = None,
                   rebalance_date: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Builds a WRDS job from the app's run inputs (factor columns, their directions and
    display labels, and the WRDS sidebar settings).

    Values are normalized (ints, floats, sorted sectors) so equal inputs always give an
    identical job and therefore the same cache key. Factor order is kept.
    """
    labels = factor_labels or {}
    factors = list(factors)
    job = {
        'kind': kind,
        'data_mode': 'wrds',
        'wrds_job_version': WRDS_JOB_VERSION,
        'factors': factors,
        'factor_directions': {f: factor_directions.get(f, 'top') for f in factors},
        'factor_labels': {f: labels.get(f, f) for f in factors},
        'frequency': settings.get('frequency'),
        'start_year': int(settings['start_year']),
        'end_year': int(settings['end_year']),
        'initial_aum': float(settings['initial_aum']),
        'top_pct': WRDS_TOP_PCT,
        'use_market_cap_weight': bool(settings.get('use_market_cap_weight', False)),
        'factor_combination': settings.get('factor_combination', 'mixing'),
        'restrict_fossil_fuels': bool(settings.get('restrict_fossil_fuels', False)),
        'selected_sectors': sorted(settings.get('selected_sectors') or []),
        'cohort_pct': float(cohort_pct) if kind == 'cohort' and cohort_pct is not None else None,
        'rebalance_date': rebalance_date if kind == 'ranked' else None,
    }
    validate_wrds_job(job)
    return job

def validate_wrds_job(job: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """Raises ValueError with a readable message when a WRDS job cannot be run."""
    if not isinstance(job, dict):
        raise ValueError("A WRDS backtest request must be a JSON object.")
    if missing := [k for k in WRDS_JOB_FIELDS if k not in job]:
        raise ValueError(f"The WRDS backtest request is missing {missing}.")
    if unknown := [k for k in job if k not in WRDS_JOB_FIELDS]:
        raise ValueError(f"The WRDS backtest request has unknown fields {unknown}.")
    if job['data_mode'] != 'wrds':
        raise ValueError("A WRDS backtest request needs data_mode 'wrds'.")
    if job['wrds_job_version'] != WRDS_JOB_VERSION:
        raise ValueError(f"wrds_job_version {job['wrds_job_version']} is not supported (expected {WRDS_JOB_VERSION}).")
    if job['kind'] not in WRDS_JOB_KINDS:
        raise ValueError(f"kind must be one of {WRDS_JOB_KINDS}, not '{job['kind']}'.")

    factors = job['factors']
    if not isinstance(factors, list) or not factors:
        raise ValueError("A backtest needs at least one factor.")
    if len(set(factors)) != len(factors):
        raise ValueError("Each factor can be chosen only once.")
    if bad := [f for f in factors if f not in WRDS_FACTOR_COLUMNS]:
        raise ValueError(f"Not WRDS factors: {bad}.")
    if set(job['factor_directions']) != set(factors) or set(job['factor_labels']) != set(factors):
        raise ValueError("factor_directions and factor_labels must have exactly the job's factors.")
    if bad := [d for d in job['factor_directions'].values() if d not in ('top', 'bottom')]:
        raise ValueError(f"Factor directions must be 'top' or 'bottom', not {bad}.")
    if bad := [v for v in job['factor_labels'].values() if not isinstance(v, str) or not v]:
        raise ValueError(f"Factor labels must be text, not {bad}.")

    if job['frequency'] not in FREQUENCIES:
        raise ValueError(f"frequency must be one of {FREQUENCIES}, not '{job['frequency']}'.")
    for key in ('start_year', 'end_year'):
        if not isinstance(job[key], int) or isinstance(job[key], bool):
            raise ValueError(f"{key} must be a whole number.")
    months = period_boundaries(job['frequency'], job['start_year'], job['end_year'])   # readable ValueError
    if not _is_number(job['initial_aum']) or job['initial_aum'] <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Initial AUM must be greater than $0.")
    if not _is_number(job['top_pct']) or not 0 < job['top_pct'] <= 100:
        raise ValueError("top_pct must be above 0 and at most 100.")
    for key in ('use_market_cap_weight', 'restrict_fossil_fuels'):
        if not isinstance(job[key], bool):
            raise ValueError(f"{key} must be true or false.")
    if job['factor_combination'] not in FACTOR_COMBINATIONS:
        raise ValueError(f"factor_combination must be one of {FACTOR_COMBINATIONS}, not '{job['factor_combination']}'.")
    sectors = job['selected_sectors']
    if not isinstance(sectors, list) or sectors != sorted(set(sectors)):
        raise ValueError("selected_sectors must be a sorted list without repeats.")
    if bad := [s for s in sectors if s not in WRDS_SECTORS]:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown GICS sectors: {bad}.")

    if job['kind'] == 'cohort':
        if not _is_number(job['cohort_pct']) or not 0 < job['cohort_pct'] <= 50:
            raise ValueError("A cohort comparison needs cohort_pct above 0 and at most 50.")
    elif job['cohort_pct'] is not None:
        raise ValueError("cohort_pct is only for cohort comparisons.")
    if job['kind'] == 'ranked':
        date = job['rebalance_date']
        if not isinstance(date, str) or not _MONTH.match(date):
            raise ValueError("A ranked list needs rebalance_date as 'YYYY-MM'.")
        if date not in months[:-1]:
            raise ValueError(f"{date} is not a rebalance month of this backtest "
                             f"({months[0]} to {months[-2]}, {job['frequency']}).")
    elif job['rebalance_date'] is not None:
        raise ValueError("rebalance_date is only for ranked lists.")

def describe_wrds_job(job: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """One-line summary of a WRDS job, for logs."""
    factors = ', '.join(f"{job['factor_labels'].get(f, f)} ({job['factor_directions'][f]})" for f in job['factors'])
    extra = (f", cohort {job['cohort_pct']:g}%" if job['kind'] == 'cohort'
             else f", ranked {job['rebalance_date']}" if job['kind'] == 'ranked' else '')
    return (f"wrds {job['kind']} {job['frequency']} {job['start_year']}-{job['end_year']} "
            f"{job['factor_combination']}: {factors}{extra}")

PROJECT: Factor-Lake Portfolio Analysis MODULE: src/wrds_service.py PURPOSE: Runs WRDS backtest jobs inside AWS Lambda on the WRDS data in S3, with results cached in S3. VERSION: 2.0.0

src/backtest_service.py sends every job with data_mode 'wrds' here. For each job (src/wrds_jobs.py) the service: 1. Hashes the job with the WRDS data version (the folder and the S3 ETags of the three files the engine reads) and the WRDS code version. 2. Returns the saved result for that hash when one exists. A saved backtest whose holdings file is missing is computed again, never shown without its holdings. 3. Otherwise runs the job and saves it: a backtest's holdings first, as backtest-results/.holdings.parquet (one row group per rebalance date), then the result JSON (backtest-results/.json), which lists the holdings' dates. The result JSON therefore only exists once its holdings do. Its S3 metadata has the job's kind and a short summary, read by the list of saved analyses.

def data_version(self) -> str:
    """
    Identifies the WRDS data a backtest reads: the folder and the S3 ETags of its
    three files. Republishing any of them changes it.
    """
    parts = [self.data_dir]
    for filename in WRDS_FILES:
        head = self.manager.client.head_object(Bucket=self.manager.bucket,
                                               Key=self.manager.object_key(f'{self.data_dir}/{filename}'))
        parts.append(f"{filename}:{head['ETag'].strip(chr(34))}")
    return '|'.join(parts)

def data(self, version: Optional[str] = None) -> WrdsData:
    """The WRDS data, reused while its version is unchanged."""
    version = version or self.data_version()
    if self._data is None or self._data[0] != version:
        self._data = None   # free the old copy before downloading the new one
        started = time.perf_counter()
        self._data = (version, read_s3_wrds_data(self.manager, self.data_dir))
        logger.info(f"Loaded the WRDS data ({self.data_dir}) in {time.perf_counter() - started:.1f} s")
    return self._data[1]

def run(self, job: Dict[str, Any], version: Optional[str] = None) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], Optional[pd.DataFrame]]:
    """
    Runs a WRDS job (src/wrds_jobs.py) on the WRDS data.

    Returns:
        backtest: (run_wrds_backtest results, holdings DataFrame).
        cohort: ({'top', 'bottom': portfolio values, 'years', 'cohort_pct', 'top_cagr',
            'bottom_cagr'}, None), the strategy at cohort_pct and its exact opposite.
        ranked: ({'rebalance_date', 'columns', 'rows'}, None), every stock on that date
            ranked (src/wrds_engine.rank_stocks).
    """
    validate_wrds_job(job)
    data = self.data(version)
    factors, directions, options = engine_arguments(job)
    if job['kind'] == 'backtest':
        return run_wrds_backtest(data, factors, directions, **options)
    if job['kind'] == 'cohort':
        options['top_pct'] = job['cohort_pct']
        top, _ = run_wrds_backtest(data, factors, directions, **options)
        inverse = {f: 'bottom' if d == 'top' else 'top' for f, d in directions.items()}
        bottom, _ = run_wrds_backtest(data, factors, inverse, **options)
        return {'top': top['portfolio_values'], 'bottom': bottom['portfolio_values'], 'years': top['years'],
                'cohort_pct': job['cohort_pct'], 'top_cagr': top['cagr'], 'bottom_cagr': bottom['cagr']}, None
    date = data.month_date(job['rebalance_date'])
    table = rank_stocks(data, date, factors, directions, job['factor_combination'], job['top_pct'],
                        job['use_market_cap_weight'], job['restrict_fossil_fuels'], job['selected_sectors'])
    return {'rebalance_date': date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'), 'columns': list(table.columns),
            'rows': table.to_dict('records')}, None

def run(self, job: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """The job's result, from the cache when possible (see the module docstring)."""
    validate_wrds_job(job)
    data_version = self.runner.data_version()
    key = job_hash(job, data_version, self.code_version)
    filename = result_file(key)

    cached = self.service._read_cached(filename)
    if cached is not None and job['kind'] == 'backtest' and not self._exists(holdings_file(RESULTS_DIR, key)):
        logger.warning(f"Holdings of {key[:12]} are missing; computing the result again")
        cached = None
    if cached is not None:
        body, info = cached
        logger.info(f"Cache hit {key[:12]} for {describe_wrds_job(job)}")
    else:
        started = time.perf_counter()
        result, holdings = self.runner.run(job, data_version)
        if holdings is not None:
            result['holdings'] = self._save_holdings(key, holdings)
        info = {
            'computed_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'),
            'compute_seconds': f"{time.perf_counter() - started:.3f}",
            # Read by the list of saved analyses without downloading each result
            'kind': job['kind'],
            'summary': summarize_wrds_job(job),
        }
        body = encode_saved(job, result)   # with its job, so the hash alone can reopen it
        self._put(filename, body, 'application/json', info)
        logger.info(f"Computed {key[:12]} in {info['compute_seconds']} s ({len(body)} bytes) "
                    f"for {describe_wrds_job(job)}")
    return self.service._respond(key, filename, body, info, cached is not None, data_version,
                                 self.code_version)

def summarize_wrds_job(job: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """
    A short description of a WRDS job for listings: the data source and frequency, then
    Legacy's summary, e.g. "WRDS, Quarterly | ROE (higher), ROA (higher) | Mixing |
    2008-2026 | $1,000". Stored as S3 metadata, so it is kept ASCII and short.
    """
    frequency = FREQUENCY_LABELS.get(job['frequency'], job['frequency'])
    return f"WRDS, {frequency} | {summarize_job(job)}".encode('ascii', 'replace').decode()[:500]
